title: Workshop: Daily routines
goal: Compare two daily routines in different cities, understand people describing their schedules and chores, and add new words for routines and housework.

items.en: to hurry, to be in a hurry

example.fr: Le matin, je me dépêche toujours.
example.en: In the morning, I'm always in a hurry.

example.fr: Le dimanche, nous nous promenons au parc.
example.en: On Sundays, we go for a walk in the park.

items.note: Like se lever: je me promène, but nous nous promenons.
In Québec, you will also hear faire le lavage.

example.fr: Je mange. Après, je fais la vaisselle.
example.en: I eat. Afterwards, I do the dishes.

example.fr: Le midi, je mange au travail.
example.en: At lunchtime, I eat at work.

steps.title: Montréal and Paris, same day
steps.intro: A new situation: Nguyen, in Montréal, has a video call with his sister Linh, in Paris. There are six hours between them.

blocks.title: A video call between Montréal and Paris
blocks.context: It's 7 a.m. in Montréal and 1 p.m. in Paris.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.fr: Salut Nguyen ! Ça va ? Il est quelle heure à Montréal ?
lines.en: Hi Nguyen! How are you? What time is it in Montréal?

lines.speaker: Nguyen
lines.fr: Salut Linh ! Ici, il est sept heures du matin. Mon réveil sonne à six heures. Je me douche, je me rase, je m'habille… et maintenant, je me dépêche !
lines.en: Hi Linh! Here, it's seven in the morning. My alarm goes off at six. I shower, I shave, I get dressed… and now I'm in a hurry!

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.fr: Ici, à Paris, il est treize heures. Le midi, je mange toujours au restaurant avec mes collègues, vers midi.
lines.en: Here, in Paris, it's 1 p.m. At lunchtime, I always eat at a restaurant with my colleagues, around noon.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.fr: Non, jamais. Le samedi, je fais la lessive et le ménage. L'après-midi, je me promène au parc. Et toi ?
lines.en: No, never. On Saturdays, I do the laundry and the housework. In the afternoon, I go for a walk in the park. And you?

lines.speaker: Nguyen
lines.fr: Moi, la fin de semaine, je fais la grasse matinée ! Je me lève vers dix heures. Après, je vais au marché et je fais la cuisine.
lines.en: Me, on weekends, I sleep in! I get up around ten. Afterwards, I go to the market and I do the cooking.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.en: And in the evening, during the week?

lines.speaker: Nguyen
lines.fr: Je rentre à dix-huit heures. Je prépare le souper, je fais la vaisselle et je regarde la télé. Je me couche à vingt-deux heures.
lines.en: I get home at six. I make supper, I do the dishes and I watch TV. I go to bed at ten.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.fr: Le souper ? À Paris, on dit « le dîner » ! Moi, je rentre tard, vers vingt heures. Mon mari fait souvent la cuisine, et nous mangeons à vingt et une heures.
lines.en: Supper? In Paris, we say “le dîner”! Me, I get home late, around eight. My husband often does the cooking, and we eat at nine.

lines.speaker: Nguyen
lines.fr: Vingt et une heures ! C'est tard !

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.fr: À Paris, c'est normal ! Et le dimanche, je fais la sieste après le déjeuner.
lines.en: In Paris, that's normal! And on Sundays, I take a nap after lunch.

lines.speaker: Nguyen
lines.fr: La sieste ? Moi, je ne fais jamais la sieste. Oh là là, il est sept heures vingt ! Je me dépêche !
lines.en: A nap? Me, I never take a nap. Oh no, it's 7:20! I have to hurry!

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.en: Have a nice day, Nguyen! See you Sunday!

blocks.prompt: What does Linh do on Saturdays?
options: The laundry and the housework, then a walk
blocks.explain: [[je fais la lessive et le ménage… je me promène au parc]]. It's Nguyen who sleeps in.

blocks.prompt: Who eats dinner later in the evening?
blocks.explain: [[nous mangeons à vingt et une heures]]. Nguyen gets home at 18 h and goes to bed at 22 h.
[[je ne fais jamais la sieste]]: ne… jamais around the verb.

blocks.title: Unit 5 in one table
head: you want to say…
French
lesson

je me douche, je m'habille, nous nous levons

blocks.title: Time, action, how often
blocks.body:
Nguyen and Linh build every sentence the same way: **a time** ([[le samedi]], [[vers dix heures]]), **an action** ([[je fais la lessive]], [[je me promène]]) and sometimes **how often** ([[toujours]], [[ne… jamais]]).

The new words add detail: more chores with [[faire]], more reflexive verbs, and [[vers]] for times that are not exact.

blocks.title: New words for routines and chores

blocks.body:
- In Québec, [[faire le lavage]] is very common for *doing the laundry*; [[faire la lessive]] is understood everywhere. For the dishes, you may hear [[laver la vaisselle]], but [[faire la vaisselle]] is the standard phrase.
- [[Le midi]] is lunchtime everywhere, and in Québec lunch is [[le dîner]]. That is why Nguyen says [[le souper]] in the evening and Linh, in Paris, says [[le dîner]].
- [[faire la sieste]] and [[faire une sieste]] are both common and correct.

- [[je me dépêche]], not *je dépêche*: the reflexive pronoun is part of the verb.
- [[nous nous promenons]] (no accent), but [[je me promène]] (è): same pattern as [[se lever]].
- [[vers]] goes **before** the time: [[vers dix heures]]. For an exact time, use [[à]]: [[à dix heures]].
- [[après le déjeuner]] = after lunch (with a noun); [[après,]] alone = afterwards.

blocks.title: Raj's message about the chores
blocks.context: Raj leaves a voice message for his roommate, Olivier.
blocks.fr: Salut Olivier ! C'est Raj. Pour la semaine : le lundi, je fais la vaisselle et toi, tu fais la lessive. Le mercredi, on fait le ménage ensemble, vers dix-neuf heures. Le vendredi, je vais au marché. Et le samedi matin, je fais la grasse matinée, alors pas de musique, s'il te plaît ! Merci et à ce soir !
blocks.en: Hi Olivier! It's Raj. For the week: on Mondays, I do the dishes and you do the laundry. On Wednesdays, we clean the house together, around 7 p.m. On Fridays, I go to the market. And on Saturday mornings, I sleep in, so no music, please! Thanks and see you tonight!

blocks.fr: Le lundi, je fais la vaisselle et toi, tu fais la lessive.
blocks.en: On Mondays, I do the dishes and you do the laundry.
blocks.prompt: What does Olivier do on Mondays?
blocks.explain: [[toi, tu fais la lessive]]. Raj does [[la vaisselle]].

blocks.fr: Le mercredi, on fait le ménage ensemble, vers dix-neuf heures.
blocks.en: On Wednesdays, we clean the house together, around 7 p.m.
blocks.explain: [[vers dix-neuf heures]] = around 19 h, 7 p.m. [[vers]] means it's not exact.

blocks.fr: Et le samedi matin, je fais la grasse matinée, alors pas de musique, s'il te plaît !
blocks.en: And on Saturday mornings, I sleep in, so no music, please!
blocks.prompt: What does Raj ask for on Saturday mornings?
options: No music, because he sleeps in
blocks.explain: [[je fais la grasse matinée]] = I sleep in; [[pas de musique]] = no music.

blocks.title: Sofia on the radio: working nights
blocks.context: Sofia, a nurse, talks about her week on a radio show for newcomers.
blocks.fr: Je suis infirmière à l'hôpital, et cette semaine, je travaille la nuit. Je commence à vingt-trois heures et je termine à sept heures du matin. Après, je rentre à la maison, je me douche et je me couche vers huit heures. Je me réveille à quinze heures. L'après-midi, je me promène un peu ou je fais les courses. Je ne fais jamais le ménage le soir : je me repose avant le travail !
blocks.en: I'm a nurse at the hospital, and this week I work nights. I start at 11 p.m. and I finish at 7 a.m. Afterwards, I go home, I shower and I go to bed around eight. I wake up at 3 p.m. In the afternoon, I go for a little walk or I do the shopping. I never do the housework in the evening: I rest before work!

blocks.fr: Je commence à vingt-trois heures et je termine à sept heures du matin.
blocks.en: I start at 11 p.m. and I finish at 7 a.m.
blocks.prompt: What are Sofia's hours this week?
blocks.explain: [[vingt-trois heures]] = 23 h = 11 p.m.; [[sept heures du matin]] = 7 a.m.

blocks.fr: Après, je rentre à la maison, je me douche et je me couche vers huit heures. Je me réveille à quinze heures.
blocks.en: Afterwards, I go home, I shower and I go to bed around eight. I wake up at 3 p.m.
blocks.explain: [[quinze heures]] = 15 h = 3 p.m. She goes to bed [[vers huit heures]] in the morning.

blocks.fr: Je ne fais jamais le ménage le soir : je me repose avant le travail !
blocks.en: I never do the housework in the evening: I rest before work!
blocks.prompt: What does Sofia do in the evening before work?
options: She takes a shower and shaves.
blocks.explain: [[je me repose]] = I rest. [[je ne fais jamais le ménage le soir]] = I never clean in the evening.

blocks.fr: Je me dépêche, il est huit heures !
accept: Je me dépêche, il est 8 heures !
Je me dépêche, il est 8 h !
blocks.explain: dépêche has é then ê, and the reflexive [[me]] comes before the verb.

blocks.fr: Après le souper, nous faisons la vaisselle.
blocks.explain: nous faisons: the ai sounds like *e* in *le*.

steps.title: Mixed practice
steps.intro: Eight questions on this unit and four that mix in Units 1 to 4.

blocks.text: Le samedi, nous ___ promenons au parc.
blocks.en: On Saturdays, we go for a walk in the park.
blocks.explain: nous + **nous** + verb: [[nous nous promenons]].

blocks.prompt: I'm always in a hurry in the morning.
accept: Je me dépêche toujours le matin.
Le matin, je me dépêche toujours.
blocks.explain: [[se dépêcher]] is reflexive; [[toujours]] goes right after the verb.

optionFeedback: aller is for places: il va au travail.
fais is for je and tu; il → fait.

accept: Je ne fais jamais la sieste.
blocks.explain: [[ne… jamais]] around the verb [[fais]].

blocks.text: Après le travail, je vais ___ marché.
blocks.en: After work, I go to the market.
blocks.explain: [[le marché]] → à + le = [[au]].
[[vers]] + time; and remember the e in [[nous mangeons]].

blocks.fr: Elle se lève vers six heures et demie.
accept: Elle se lève vers 6 heures et demie.
blocks.explain: [[se lève]] with è; [[et demie]] ends in -e after heure.

blocks.text: Karim travaille la nuit, mais ___ femme travaille le jour. (his)
blocks.en: Karim works at night, but his wife works during the day.
blocks.explain: Lesson 4.1: [[femme]] is feminine → [[sa]], even for Karim.

blocks.fr: Le cours commence à vingt heures quinze.
blocks.explain: Lesson 3.4: [[vingt heures quinze]] = 20 h 15 = 8:15 p.m.

blocks.prompt: My niece lives in Quebec City.
blocks.explain: Lessons 2.3 and 4.6: the city takes [[à]]: [[à Québec]].

blocks.prompt: A colleague tells you the meeting time, but you didn't hear. What do you say?
options: Pardon ? Pouvez-vous répéter, s'il vous plaît ?
blocks.explain: Lesson 1.5: the survival phrases still work in every unit.

blocks.prompt: You have a new roommate. Write a message about your routine and suggest who does which chores during the week.
blocks.promptFr: Écrivez un message à votre colocataire : votre routine et les tâches de la semaine.
checklist: Your morning: two reflexive verbs with times (à or vers)
When you go to work or class and get home
Two or three chores with faire, and who does them (je / tu / on)
One day with le + day (le lundi…)
One frequency word, including ne… jamais if you can

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Salut Alex ! Moi, je me lève à 6 heures. Je me douche vers 6 h 15. Je vais au travail à 7 heures et je rentre vers 17 heures. Pour la maison : le lundi, je fais la vaisselle et toi, tu fais la lessive. Le samedi, on fait le ménage. D'accord ? Merci !
models.en: Hi Alex! I get up at 6. I shower around 6:15. I go to work at 7 and I get home around 5 p.m. For the house: on Mondays, I do the dishes and you do the laundry. On Saturdays, we clean the house. OK? Thanks!

models.label: Stronger model answer
models.fr: Salut Mei ! En semaine, mon réveil sonne à 6 heures. Je me douche, je m'habille et je me dépêche : je commence à 7 h 30. Je rentre vers 18 heures. Pour les tâches, je propose : le lundi, je fais la vaisselle ; le mardi, tu fais la lessive. Le samedi, on fait le ménage ensemble. Le dimanche, je fais souvent la sieste, mais je ne travaille jamais !
models.en: Hi Mei! During the week, my alarm goes off at 6. I shower, I get dressed and I hurry: I start at 7:30. I get home around 6 p.m. For the chores, I suggest: on Mondays, I do the dishes; on Tuesdays, you do the laundry. On Saturdays, we clean together. On Sundays, I often take a nap, but I never work!

blocks.prompt: Like Nguyen and Linh, you have a video call with a friend or relative in another city. Describe your weekday and your weekend, and compare with theirs (use il / elle).
checklist: What time it is for you
Work or class, and when you get home
One chore with faire and one place with aller
One sentence about the other person: il / elle + verb

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Ici, à Gatineau, il est huit heures du matin. En semaine, je me lève à six heures, je me douche et je m'habille. Je vais au travail à sept heures. Je rentre vers dix-sept heures et je fais la cuisine. La fin de semaine, je me promène au parc. Mon frère, à Paris, se lève tard : il ne travaille jamais le matin !
models.en: Here, in Gatineau, it's eight in the morning. During the week, I get up at six, I shower and I get dressed. I go to work at seven. I get home around five and I do the cooking. On weekends, I go for a walk in the park. My brother, in Paris, gets up late: he never works in the morning!

models.label: Stronger model answer
models.fr: Ici, à Vancouver, il est sept heures du matin, et à Montréal, il est dix heures. En semaine, mon réveil sonne à six heures. Je me douche, je me rase et je me dépêche. Le soir, je rentre vers dix-huit heures, je fais la vaisselle et je me couche tôt. Le samedi, je fais la lessive et je vais au marché. Ma sœur, à Montréal, fait la sieste le dimanche. Moi, jamais !
models.en: Here, in Vancouver, it's seven in the morning, and in Montréal, it's ten. During the week, my alarm goes off at six. I shower, I shave and I hurry. In the evening, I get home around six, I do the dishes and I go to bed early. On Saturdays, I do the laundry and I go to the market. My sister, in Montréal, takes a nap on Sundays. Me, never!

summary:
- Compare two routines with times, reflexive verbs, faire, aller and frequency words
- Understand schedules and chores in a voice message and a radio talk
- Add detail with [[se dépêcher]], [[se promener]], [[faire la vaisselle]], [[faire la lessive]], [[faire la sieste]], [[vers]] and [[après]]

meta.author: ai
meta.notes: Fixed Linh's lunch time (it was 13 h during the call); clarified that faire la vaisselle is standard and added faire le lavage; removed untaught 'déjà' and non-homophone accepts from dictations; trimmed the stronger speaking model.
